notes: §1985:XII.2.4 GR9: an unreplaced library word starts in the area it begins in within the library; "Each text word in pseudo-text-2 that is to be placed into the resultant program begins in the same area of the resultant program as it appears in pseudo-text-2"; identifier-2, literal-2 and word-2 begin in the area of the leftmost replaced word; introduced words are on debugging lines as the rule's third paragraph says; a too-long literal is continued, and one that must be continued on a debugging line is an error. The debugging and literal arms conform: ExpandCopiesOneLevel/AppendAsDebuggingLines (COPY on a D line, p9f), ApplyReplacements/IntroducedText (p7a, p11a, p11c) and ContinuedLiterals in ApplyReplacements (COBOL7039, p11b; witness 1985-GR-XII_2_4-11, p10a). The unreplaced arm conforms (witness 1985-GR-XII_2_4-9; p9e a library paragraph header in area B is COBOL3734) and so does the word-2 arm (p9ii accepted, p9iv refused). The pseudo-text-2 arm does not: OriginWriter#Append gives every replacement line the position of the replaced library word and AreaPlacementPass#Screen judges the area there, so pseudo-text-2 words take the replaced word's area (the word-2 rule). Probes (work-rd-06/p): b) p9iii, p9v refused, p9i accepted; a) p10a; c) p3e, p9g refused COBOL0900. Also observed, root outside COPY: p9d2 (no COPY) refuses a paragraph-name beginning in column 11 after X. ("follows other text of its line"), so GR9's second sentence's case of two words in area A of one line cannot arise. kb/Work PB5313 holds the defect (code read: coderead-85/out-read4/rd-06.json).

next.reason: Amendment 1 (X3.23a-1989) completed the third paragraph's cut sentence: 'When a text word specified in the BY phrase is introduced, it appears on a debugging line if the first library text word being replaced is specified on a debugging line' (§1985:XII.2.4 GR9); that adds one more debugging-line placement case and no 2023 rule carries any of them, 2023 having no debugging lines. The subject, where copied and replacement text words go in the resultant text, has a different requirement. 1985: each word 'is copied so as to start in the same area of the line in the resultant program as it begins in the line within the library', identifier-2, literal-2 and word-2 begin 'in the same area' as the matched word, and for a long literal 'additional continuation lines are introduced which contain the remainder of the literal'. §2023:7.2.3.4 GR11 instead: 'The resultant text after replacement shall be in logical free-form reference format', where 'additional spaces may be introduced only between text-words where there already exists a space or at the end of a source line'; there are no area A/B or continuation rules for the result. 'Library text must conform to the rules for COBOL reference format' survives as §2023:6.1 GR1 b) 'A COBOL compiler shall accept source text and library text written in reference format'.
